items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a – he played with Damita Jo, the singer. He was with her.

ctx.x: My brother? Oh yeah. He was a – he played with Damita Jo, the singer. He was with her. He used to sing with her too. And he played with some other trios. But he died many years ago.
I read that you two were very close when you were growing up.
